method: Exploratory comparison before the region fix. 15 alternating direct SELECT executions per variant, same local DB buffers; median milliseconds. Current is the existing derived MAX aggregation, joined is an outer grouped metadata join, correlated is a scalar per-recipe MAX subquery. Only non-filtered catalog comparisons are retained here; SQL and EXPLAIN are included for reproducibility. Not a production benchmark.

current.sql:
SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS  wp_posts.ID
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN (SELECT post_id, MAX(CAST(meta_value AS DECIMAL(20,4))) AS value FROM wp_postmeta WHERE meta_key = '_recipe_time' GROUP BY post_id) AS cooklook_sort ON wp_posts.ID = cooklook_sort.post_id
					 WHERE 1=1  AND wp_posts.post_password = '' AND wp_posts.post_type = 'recipe' AND ((wp_posts.post_status = 'publish'))
					 
					 ORDER BY COALESCE(cooklook_sort.value, 0) ASC, wp_posts.post_date DESC, wp_posts.ID DESC
					 LIMIT 0, 11

plan.Extra: Using where; Using temporary; Using filesort
